title: Detailed laptop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='screenGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#1a2a4a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0d1b2a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='baseGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c0c8d8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a96a8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lidGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9aa8bc'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7a8898'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='keyArea' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#3a4a5a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2a3a4a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Laptop lid / monitor back -->
  <rect x='18' y='8' width='64' height='48' rx='3' fill='url(#lidGrad)'/>
  <!-- Lid edge highlight -->
  <rect x='18' y='8' width='64' height='2' rx='1' fill='#d0d8e8'/>

  <!-- Screen bezel -->
  <rect x='22' y='12' width='56' height='40' rx='2' fill='#1a2230'/>
  <!-- Screen display -->
  <rect x='25' y='15' width='50' height='34' rx='1' fill='url(#screenGlow)'/>

  <!-- Screen content: little desktop window -->
  <rect x='28' y='18' width='24' height='15' rx='1.5' fill='#2e6b9e'/>
  <!-- Window title bar -->
  <rect x='28' y='18' width='24' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#5a9fd4'/>
  <!-- Window dots -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='20' r='1' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='20' r='1' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='20' r='1' fill='#6bff8e'/>
  <!-- Content lines -->
  <rect x='30' y='25' width='16' height='1.5' rx='0.75' fill='#8ec8f0'/>
  <rect x='30' y='28' width='12' height='1.5' rx='0.75' fill='#8ec8f0'/>
  <rect x='30' y='31' width='14' height='1.5' rx='0.75' fill='#6aacda'/>

  <!-- Small cursor icon -->
  <polygon points='64,24 64,32 61,29 58,30 60,27' fill='#f0f4ff' stroke='#5a9fd4' stroke-width='0.5'/>

  <!-- Taskbar -->
  <rect x='25' y='44' width='50' height='4' rx='0.5' fill='#1d3557'/>
  <rect x='27' y='45' width='4' height='2' rx='0.5' fill='#457b9d'/>
  <rect x='33' y='45' width='4' height='2' rx='0.5' fill='#e63946'/>
  <rect x='39' y='45' width='4' height='2' rx='0.5' fill='#2a9d8f'/>

  <!-- Hinge -->
  <rect x='18' y='55' width='64' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#6a7a8a'/>
  <rect x='28' y='55' width='44' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8a9aaa'/>

  <!-- Laptop base / keyboard deck -->
  <polygon points='12,74 22,58 78,58 88,74' fill='url(#baseGrad)'/>

  <!-- Keyboard area -->
  <polygon points='20,62 26,59 74,59 80,62 76,71 24,71' fill='url(#keyArea)'/>

  <!-- Keys - row 1 -->
  <rect x='25' y='60.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='30.5' y='60.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='36' y='60.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='41.5' y='60.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='47' y='60.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='52.5' y='60.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='60.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='63.5' y='60.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='69' y='60.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>

  <!-- Keys - row 2 -->
  <rect x='25' y='64.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='30.5' y='64.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='36' y='64.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='41.5' y='64.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='47' y='64.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='52.5' y='64.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='64.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='63.5' y='64.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='69' y='64.5' width='4.5' height='3' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>

  <!-- Spacebar row -->
  <rect x='30' y='68.5' width='4' height='2.5' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='35' y='68.5' width='24' height='2.5' rx='0.5' fill='#5a6a7a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='68.5' width='4' height='2.5' rx='0.5' fill='#4a5a6a'/>

  <!-- Touchpad -->
  <rect x='38' y='73' width='18' height='4' rx='1' fill='#9aa8b8'/>
  <rect x='38' y='73' width='18' height='1' rx='0.5' fill='#b0bcc8'/>

  <!-- Front edge highlight -->
  <polygon points='12,74 22,58 24,58 14,74' fill='#d8e0e8'/>
  <polygon points='76,71 80,62 82,62 78,71' fill='#d8e0e8'/>

  <!-- Base front lip -->
  <rect x='12' y='73' width='76' height='2' rx='1' fill='#b0bcc8'/>

  <!-- Small LED indicator -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='72' r='1' fill='#6bff8e'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='72' r='0.5' fill='#aaffcc'/>
</svg>
